race.comment: WINGS OF CARMEN (8) will resume off a preparation which included a win at Sandown. That was on good going but showed he can do it on softer tracks too. Anything like his Melbourne form lines has to have him right in the finish off a good trial. FORREST GUMP (5) has had two trials for him to be ready. He could well be one preferring a damper track but most of his runs to date have been more than adequate. VADERLEE (9) ran favourite second up at this track and was better again. Just needs some luck from this awkward draw. HELLBERG (6) will be one of, if not the leader in the race. He has been consistent running off that position recently. PRINCESS GEISHA (11) broke her maiden right here three weeks back. This race might be run the same.
